## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence of the 26 documents of the four policies (hub, baseline, factors) and of premium_account_rules_5f3ef08c / billing_plans_and_service_charges_6a0b1dbc / notice_periods_f30c6e6f was traced to a source sentence, ladder, parameter, measure or tool contract. Worked figures were re-computed (8.004 / 12.00012 edges; 41.00 returned basis; 25.00 / 18.75 repeat cases; 60.00 / 45.00 frequency cases; pay-off examples 600.00 / 600.00 / 1,505.00; quarterly split 250.01 / 250.00) and all are correct.
- Additions / rewrites / omissions that change entailment: none.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none; each tool name occurs only in its own hub.
- Opening world state as policy fact: none (no document states a returned payment, late installment or missing fee of this customer; examples are hypothetical).

Observations (recorded, not verdict-changing):
- O1 installment_fee_amount_868e6a7d, last line: "The same fee is charged for each installment that carries one; it is posted against that installment's term and position." Under the baseline alone (fee = tier charge) this is a derivation; read as "an identical amount for every installment" it would not survive the size bands and charge-date credits of the factor documents, which is the same status as every baseline default. It neither hints at nor denies a variation in the sense of Step 3b, and it did not divert the blind reading (the installment already carrying 5.00 was not taken as the amount for installment 3). Recorded so that the wording is visible to reviewers.
- O2 pay_off_amount_291d9dd2 defines "the installments of the current term not yet billed" (the count the payoff_installment_fees factor reads) in the baseline document; it is a derivation from the baseline's own plan-count sentence and carries no hint wording.
- O3 The trigger sentence of each fee policy's and the pay-off policy's `baseline.rule` ("… found without it is charged … on the day it is found", "A named insured may pay off …") is carried in the policy's hub rather than in its computation document; every input, default, rounding and assembly step is in the computation document, so no computational content is displaced.
- Policy-side note N4 of task 0 (tool rounding via Python `round()`) applies equally to these four tools.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All 18 declared factors are carried with every tier exact, the four baselines are complete, the three prerequisites stand verbatim on the blocked side only, the four overwritten base clauses are carried as retired and the base's remaining clauses as in force; no normative claim without a source. First revision.
